harnesses.name: Codex
harnesses.description: A local coding agent that reads, edits, and runs code from the terminal.

harnesses.name: Claude Code
harnesses.description: An agentic coding tool that reads codebases, edits files, runs commands, and connects to development tools.

harnesses.name: Grok Build
harnesses.description: A terminal coding agent and TUI for editing code, running commands, web search, and long-running tasks.

harnesses.name: OpenCode
harnesses.description: An open-source coding agent for the terminal, IDE, and desktop that can connect to models from many providers.

harnesses.name: Headroom
harnesses.description: Compresses tool outputs, logs, files, and RAG chunks with content-aware compressors before they reach the model—claimed 20% fewer tokens for coding agents and 60–95% fewer for JSON, same answers. Ships as a library, HTTP proxy, or MCP server, so it drops in…

harnesses.name: awesome-cursorrules
harnesses.description: Curated .cursorrules and skills that leverage Cursor's index-then-load model; the canonical collection for rules-as-progressive-disclosure in the IDE.

harnesses.name: agents.md
harnesses.description: Open format for repo-scoped agent briefings; nested AGENTS.md files scope instructions per directory, so agents get a map of what exists and load only what's relevant. Read by 20+ tools including Codex, Cursor, and Copilot.

harnesses.name: context-mode
harnesses.description: Context-window optimization layer that sandboxes tool output before it reaches the model (claimed 98% reduction) and persists session memory across 17 agent platforms via MCP and hooks—progressive disclosure applied to tool results, not just instructions.

harnesses.name: langgraph-bigtool
harnesses.description: Build LangGraph agents with large tool sets; retrieval and on-demand tool loading so agents scale beyond context without stuffing every schema upfront.

harnesses.name: MCP-Zero
harnesses.description: Active tool discovery for autonomous agents: model requests tools by requirement; hierarchical semantic routing over 308 servers / 2,797 tools with ~98% token reduction (APIBank).

harnesses.name: ToolGen
harnesses.description: ICLR 2025: unified tool retrieval and calling via generation; 47k+ tools without context stuffing—retrieval and invocation in one generative step.

harnesses.name: ToolRAG
harnesses.description: Semantic tool retrieval for LLMs; serves only the tools the user query demands (MCP-compatible), unlimited tool sets with zero context penalty.

harnesses.name: Gemini CLI
harnesses.description: Google's first-party terminal agent for Gemini. The harness is the plugin/MCP tool-call loop; the terminal is the shell—Google's parallel to Claude Code / Codex, not just an API.

harnesses.name: pi
harnesses.description: The upstream AI agent toolkit behind this list's oh-my-pi fork: a unified multi-provider LLM API, agent loop, and TUI shell providing the harness that oh-my-pi's Rust rewrite builds on.

harnesses.name: DeepSeek Harness
harnesses.description: DeepSeek's official, plugin-first agent harness with composable runtimes for coding, code-mode execution, minimal benchmark loops, and harness creation.

harnesses.name: OpenHands
harnesses.description: Dockerized software-engineering agent. The harness is the bash/editor/browser toolset with micro-agents and event-stream session bridging; Docker is the sandbox. Main OSS choice for teams self-hosting autonomous repo work.

harnesses.name: Open Interpreter
harnesses.description: Lightweight terminal coding agent oriented to open models (DeepSeek, Kimi, Qwen). The harness is a code-execution loop — the model writes code, the harness executes it with confirmation gates; the CLI is the shell. The original "let the LLM run code on my…

harnesses.name: Cline
harnesses.description: VS Code extension whose harness is a plan-then-act loop with per-step human approval and cost transparency; the VS Code integration is the UI shell. Open-source counterweight to Cursor.

harnesses.name: goose
harnesses.description: Block-originated Rust agent, now stewarded by the Linux Foundation's Agentic AI Foundation (aaif-goose/goose). The harness is the MCP/ACP extension model with recipes and provider choice; there's no fixed UI slot—you bolt it into whatever shell you use.

harnesses.name: DeepSeek-Reasonix
harnesses.description: DeepSeek-native terminal coding agent. The harness is engineered around prefix-cache stability for long-running sessions; the TUI is the shell.

harnesses.name: vibe-kanban
harnesses.description: Kanban-style fleet manager for running Claude Code, Codex, or any coding agent across many tasks at once. The harness contribution is the task-queue/review layer on top of whichever agent executes; not an agent loop itself.

harnesses.name: crush
harnesses.description: Charm's terminal coding agent (Charm's fork of the original OpenCode). The harness is the tool-calling loop with session persistence; the Bubble Tea TUI is the shell.

harnesses.name: qwen-code
harnesses.description: Alibaba's official terminal coding agent, forked from Gemini CLI's agent loop and retuned for Qwen models. The harness is the same sandboxed tool-call loop as its upstream; the terminal is the shell.

harnesses.name: Kilo Code
harnesses.description: VS Code extension and CLI in the Cline/Roo-Code lineage — a natural pick now that Roo-Code is archived upstream. The harness is an approval-gated autonomous-mode loop with a provider/tool marketplace; the IDE is the shell.

harnesses.name: Symphony
harnesses.description: OpenAI's harness for fanning a task out into many isolated, autonomous coding-agent implementation runs and surfacing the ones that pass, so a team manages outcomes instead of supervising each session.

harnesses.name: Roo Code
harnesses.description: VS Code/Cursor extension in the Cline lineage. The harness is the approval-gated agent with custom modes and a strong MCP story; the IDE is the UI. Popular community fork when you want that workflow without the upstream extension.

harnesses.name: oh-my-pi
harnesses.description: Terminal coding agent (fork of Pi) that wires the IDE into the harness: hash-anchored edits, a 32-tool loop tuned per-model, LSP rename/references/diagnostics on every write, a real DAP debugger (lldb/dlv/debugpy), long-lived Python + Bun execution kernels…

harnesses.name: jcode
harnesses.description: Rust terminal coding agent pitched as the most RAM-efficient harness in its class; MCP support, multi-provider (Claude/OpenAI).

harnesses.name: eigent
harnesses.description: Open-source desktop harness positioned as a local, free alternative to Claude Cowork and Codex: multi-agent workspace orchestration in a self-hosted app rather than a hosted product.

harnesses.name: cc-haha
harnesses.description: Local-first desktop workspace harness for Claude Code and other agents: multi-agent sessions, Git worktrees, code diffs, a skill marketplace, and chat-app access (WeChat, Telegram, WhatsApp).

harnesses.name: Kimi CLI
harnesses.description: Moonshot AI's open-source terminal coding agent, with an agent loop, shell and file tools, skills, MCP support, and Kimi model integration.

harnesses.name: claw-code-agent
harnesses.description: Python reimplementation of the Claude Code agent architecture with zero external dependencies; interactive chat, streaming, plugin runtime, nested agent delegation, cost tracking, MCP transport—portable harness without the Rust/TS toolchain.

harnesses.name: AgentBox
harnesses.description: Runs multiple coding agents in parallel, each in its own sandboxed VM, locally or in the cloud, from one command. The harness contribution is the VM-per-agent isolation and fleet fan-out layer; whichever agent runs inside owns the loop.

harnesses.name: Proliferate
harnesses.description: Open-source AI IDE for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and more. The harness contribution is the workspace/session orchestration layer: run multiple coding agents in parallel, locally or in the cloud, with isolated workspaces, reusable workflows, and shared…

harnesses.name: agent-harness (Go)
harnesses.description: A clean-room Go coding harness with streaming, permissioned tools, interactive and autonomous modes, encrypted credentials, sessions, and layered configuration.

harnesses.name: Amp
harnesses.description: Sourcegraph's agentic coding harness, available through a CLI and editor integrations, with repository context, tools, threads, and team sharing.

harnesses.name: Cursor Agent
harnesses.description: Cursor's IDE-native coding harness for autonomous code exploration, editing, command execution, planning, review, and background agents.

harnesses.name: Devin
harnesses.description: Cognition's hosted software-engineering agent harness with a sandboxed development environment, browser, shell, editor, planning, and collaboration surfaces.

harnesses.name: Factory Droid
harnesses.description: Factory's software-development agent harness for interactive and autonomous work across a CLI, IDE, web, and managed enterprise environments.

harnesses.name: GitHub Copilot coding agent
harnesses.description: GitHub's background coding harness that works from issues and prompts in an ephemeral environment, validates changes, and opens pull requests for review.

harnesses.name: Honk
harnesses.description: Spotify's internal background coding harness: Claude Agent SDK sessions run in Kubernetes, use trusted tools and CI, and feed Fleetshift-managed migrations and pull requests.

harnesses.name: Xirp
harnesses.description: Spotify's beta agentic development environment with institutional memory, connecting AI coding sessions to services, ownership, documentation, and architectural decisions across local and remote work.

harnesses.name: Jules
harnesses.description: Google's asynchronous coding-agent harness that clones repositories into cloud VMs, plans and executes changes, and returns branches or pull requests.

harnesses.name: Junie
harnesses.description: JetBrains' coding-agent harness integrated into JetBrains IDEs and GitHub for delegated implementation, testing, and code review.

harnesses.name: Kiro
harnesses.description: AWS's spec-driven coding-agent harness with CLI and IDE surfaces, steering files, hooks, skills, MCP servers, and autonomous execution controls.

harnesses.name: Replit Agent
harnesses.description: Replit's hosted software-building harness that plans, writes, tests, and deploys applications inside the Replit workspace.

harnesses.name: Windsurf Cascade
harnesses.description: Windsurf's IDE-native agent harness with codebase context, planning, tool calls, terminal access, checkpoints, memories, rules, and MCP integrations.

harnesses.name: superpowers
harnesses.description: Performance-oriented harness pack for Claude Code and 13 other harnesses (Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, more): skills, instincts, memory, security, research-first workflows. Treats harness engineering itself as the performance lever.

harnesses.name: Anthropic Skills
harnesses.description: Anthropic's official Agent Skills repository: SKILL.md-based folders (instructions, scripts, resources) Claude dynamically loads on Claude Code, Claude.ai, and the API. The reference for progressive-disclosure skill packs in 2026.

harnesses.name: GStack
harnesses.description: Garry Tan's Claude Code skill stack: 23 slash-command modes (CEO/eng/design review, QA, ship, browse, retro, …) that structure one assistant as a virtual engineering team. Daily driver while running YC.

harnesses.name: addyosmani/agent-skills
harnesses.description: Addy Osmani's production-grade skill pack: 24 engineering skills and 4 specialist agent personas that encode senior-dev workflows (spec through deploy) across 70+ coding agents including Claude Code, Cursor, and Copilot. The harness contribution is the…

harnesses.name: awesome-claude-code
harnesses.description: Large community-curated index of Claude Code skills, slash commands, status lines, and plugins—resources for extending the harness, not a harness itself, but the most-followed catalog of the genre.

harnesses.name: wshobson/agents
harnesses.description: Cross-harness marketplace of drop-in subagents and skills for Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, OpenCode, and Copilot; specialized, production-ready agent definitions you install rather than hand-write.

harnesses.name: planning-with-files
harnesses.description: Skill for persistent, file-based planning across long-running coding-agent sessions: crash-proof markdown plans, session recovery after /clear/compaction, and a deterministic completion gate—Manus-style planning as a drop-in harness layer via the Agent…

harnesses.name: SWE-agent
harnesses.description: LM-driven harness built for SWE-bench: edit state, command execution, and issue-focused loop—the reference agent stack next to the benchmark itself.

harnesses.name: get-shit-done
harnesses.description: Goal-backward planning and wave-based execution over fresh context windows; avoids context rot by design. Python/JS meta-prompting for Claude Code, OpenCode, Gemini CLI.

harnesses.name: Claude Agent SDK
harnesses.description: Official Anthropic SDK (Python + TypeScript, demos, quickstarts): built-in tools, MCP, long-running coding agents with session bridging.

harnesses.name: agents-cli
harnesses.description: Google's official CLI and skill pack that layers agent-creation, evaluation, and deployment skills on top of whatever coding assistant you already run, rather than shipping its own agent loop—the harness as a config/skills add-on, not a new runtime.

harnesses.name: skillhub
harnesses.description: iFlytek's self-hosted registry for publishing, versioning, and governing agent skill packages—the harness config layer treated as an enterprise artifact store rather than a CLI or IDE shell.

harnesses.name: Meta-Harness
harnesses.description: Reference implementation from the Meta-Harness paper: an academic testbed for harness-engineering research, not a product—useful as a citation-grade baseline rather than something you'd run in production.

harnesses.name: MoAI-ADK
harnesses.description: A spec-driven Claude Code development harness with plan/run/sync workflows, quality gates, model routing, and multi-model delegation.

harnesses.name: RepoMaster
harnesses.description: Repo-scoped research harness: builds function-call and module-dependency graphs to explore only what's needed; large relative gains on MLE-bench and GitTaskBench with lower token use.

harnesses.name: HarnessX
harnesses.description: A harness foundry for composing reusable processors and bundles into model-independent agent harnesses and evolving them through training.

harnesses.name: AutoHarness
harnesses.description: Lightweight governance harness: wraps any LLM client in ~2 lines for automated harness engineering—6–14 step pipeline, YAML constitution, risk-pattern matching, session persistence with cost tracking, multi-agent profiles.

harnesses.name: LoopTroop
harnesses.description: Config layer that chains LLM councils for planning, Ralph loops for iterative refinement, and OpenCode worktrees for shipping. The harness contribution is the council → loop → worktree pipeline; OpenCode underneath executes.

harnesses.name: Harness Kit
harnesses.description: A coding-agent engineering toolkit combining dependency-aware multi-agent orchestration, an evidence-carrying task board, and reusable quality patterns.

harnesses.name: FSPEC
harnesses.description: A spec-driven multi-agent software delivery harness that turns human-authored intent into autonomous, evidence-gated implementation work.

harnesses.name: Agent Harness by Wild
harnesses.description: A TypeScript configuration compiler that manages prompts, skills, MCP servers, and subagents once, then emits native Codex, Claude, Copilot, and Cursor files.

harnesses.name: pmstack
harnesses.description: Claude Code config for AI product managers: CLAUDE.md plus skills for competitive analysis, PRD-from-signal, metric frameworks, stakeholder briefs, and agent eval design. "GStack for PMs."

harnesses.name: Autonomous Coding Harness
harnesses.description: A human-in-the-loop Claude Agent SDK harness that connects fresh sessions through durable artifacts and GitLab milestone workflows.

harnesses.name: OpenClaw
harnesses.description: Self-hosted, always-on personal agent (formerly Clawdbot/Moltbot): a gateway + event-loop runtime that treats messages, heartbeats, crons, and webhooks as one input queue, persists state to local files, and lives in your chat apps (WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack,…

harnesses.name: Hermes
harnesses.description: Nous Research's self-improving agent: a learning loop turns experience into reusable skills, builds a persistent user model across sessions, and checkpoints state to disk with rollback; lean enough for a $5 VPS, driven from chat, and model-agnostic (Nous…

harnesses.name: nanobot
harnesses.description: Ultra-lightweight, self-hosted personal agent framework: the harness is a Python daemon wiring tools, memory, and MCP into chat/webhook front ends (Telegram, Discord, web); minimal footprint alternative to heavier personal-runtime stacks.

harnesses.name: CowAgent
harnesses.description: Self-hosted harness (formerly chatgpt-on-wechat) that plans tasks, runs tools/skills, and self-evolves via memory; multi-model, multi-channel (WeChat, Telegram, etc.), one-line install.

harnesses.name: Khoj
harnesses.description: Self-hostable "AI second brain": answers over your docs and the web, custom agents, scheduled automations, and multi-client reach (web, Obsidian, Emacs, WhatsApp). A personal-agent harness with retrieval at the core.

harnesses.name: Eliza
harnesses.description: Open "agentic operating system" (elizaOS): persistent multi-agent runtime with character files, a plugin ecosystem, and social/platform integrations — the harness behind a large share of autonomous social agents.

harnesses.name: Agent Zero
harnesses.description: Organic, prompt-defined personal agent framework: hierarchical sub-agents, persistent memory, browser and code tools, and self-modifying behavior; runs in Docker with a web UI.

harnesses.name: OpenHarness (HKUDS)
harnesses.description: Open agent harness with a built-in personal agent ("Ohmo") that runs across Feishu, Slack, Telegram, and Discord; core tool-use, skills, memory, multi-agent coordination with auto-compaction for multi-day sessions.

harnesses.name: AIlice
harnesses.description: Fully autonomous general-purpose agent; one binary, Docker-ready, for when you want "set goal and walk away" without a framework.

harnesses.name: Talon
harnesses.description: Multi-platform personal agent living in Telegram, Discord, Teams, and the terminal. The harness is a pluggable-backend loop (Claude, Kilo, OpenCode, Codex, OpenAI Agents) with full MCP tool access and persistent background agents (Goals, Heartbeat, Dream);…

harnesses.name: n8n
harnesses.description: Fair-code workflow engine with 400+ nodes and native AI nodes; the self-hosted Zapier that actually does agents and LangChain.

harnesses.name: AutoGPT
harnesses.description: The original autonomous loop: goal in, agent iterates with tools and memory; Forge is the dev framework, Benchmark the eval harness.

harnesses.name: langflow
harnesses.description: Low-code UI to build and deploy LangChain/LangGraph flows; visual DAG editor and one-click run.

harnesses.name: Dify
harnesses.description: One-stop LLM app platform: visual workflows, RAG pipeline, 50+ tools, model management; "ship from prototype to prod" in a single UI.

harnesses.name: langchain
harnesses.description: Chains, tools, retrievers, and agents; the usual entry point for "add tools to an LLM" in Python/JS.

harnesses.name: browser-use
harnesses.description: Python web-agent harness: natural-language goals become browser actions, driven directly over the Chrome DevTools Protocol (it dropped Playwright in August 2025). The biggest community in the browser-agent category.

harnesses.name: Flowise
harnesses.description: Drag-and-drop LangChain UI; deploy flows without code. The low-code sibling to Langflow, with a different component and hosting story.

harnesses.name: llama-index
harnesses.description: Data-centric: indexing, RAG, and query engines; agent abstractions sit on top of your data pipelines.

harnesses.name: agno
harnesses.description: Python agents with memory, knowledge bases, tools, and structured outputs; continues the PhiData-era product line under the Agno name—production apps, evals, and pipelines.

harnesses.name: langgraph
harnesses.description: State-machine graphs over LLM steps; checkpointing, human-in-the-loop, and durable execution so workflows survive restarts.

harnesses.name: semantic-kernel
harnesses.description: Microsoft's plugin and planner layer for LLMs; C, Python, Java; strong on enterprise auth and orchestration.

harnesses.name: mastra
harnesses.description: TypeScript-first; agents, tools, and workflows with a single runtime and minimal boilerplate.

harnesses.name: Haystack
harnesses.description: Open-source orchestration framework for context-engineered LLM apps: modular pipelines and agent workflows with explicit control over retrieval, routing, memory, and generation—closer to LangChain's territory than a coding-agent harness.

harnesses.name: letta
harnesses.description: Python agent runtime with tool use and control flow; lean API; stateful agents with long-horizon memory.

harnesses.name: Stagehand
harnesses.description: Browserbase's SDK for browser agents: natural-language actions (act, extract, observe) and deterministic Playwright code mix in one script, so agent flexibility and repeatable automation live in the same harness.

harnesses.name: rasa
harnesses.description: Conversational AI stack (NLU, dialogue, actions); long-standing OSS choice for chat and voice bots.

harnesses.name: Google ADK
harnesses.description: Google's official Agent Development Kit: code-first Python toolkit for building, evaluating, and deploying agents. Optimized for Gemini but model-agnostic; deploys to Cloud Run / Vertex AI; ships a dev UI with eval and a code-execution sandbox.

harnesses.name: botpress
harnesses.description: Visual bot builder and runtime; multi-channel, open-source alternative to commercial bot platforms.

harnesses.name: R2R
harnesses.description: RAG-first: hybrid search, knowledge graphs, multimodal; the framework for "production RAG" when you care more about retrieval than chat UI.

harnesses.name: agent-squad
harnesses.description: AWS-originated orchestrator (now under 2FastLabs): intent classification, streaming, SupervisorAgent; "agent-as-tools" so one agent delegates to a squad.

harnesses.name: AgentVerse
harnesses.description: Task-solving and simulation envs for multi-LLM agents; deploy many agents in custom environments without building infra from scratch.

harnesses.name: youtu-agent
harnesses.description: Tencent Cloud's agent framework: a minimal tool-calling harness designed to perform well with open-source models, positioned as a lighter alternative to heavier orchestration frameworks.

harnesses.name: Bee Agent Framework
harnesses.description: Python + TypeScript, LF AI–backed; MCP/ACP, workflows, Requirement Agent; the one that pushes "production multi-agent" without LangChain.

harnesses.name: AgentStack
harnesses.description: Scaffolds full agent projects; plugs in CrewAI, LangGraph, OpenAI Swarm, LlamaStack and wires AgentOps observability from day one.

harnesses.name: AgentSilex
harnesses.description: ~300 lines of readable agent code on top of LiteLLM; the "I want to see the whole loop" option for learning or minimal production.

harnesses.name: SuperAgentX
harnesses.description: Lightweight multi-agent orchestrator with an AGI-angle; minimal surface, docs-first, for teams that want orchestration without the kitchen sink.

harnesses.name: MetaGPT
harnesses.description: The "AI software company" multi-agent framework: role-played PM, architect, and engineer agents turn a one-line requirement into specs, designs, and code along an SOP assembly line. The landmark of the genre; development pace has slowed in 2026.

harnesses.name: autogen
harnesses.description: Conversable agents and group chats; code execution and human-in-the-loop; Microsoft origin, AG2 ecosystem. ⚠️ In maintenance mode since late 2025: no new features, and Microsoft directs new users to Agent Framework.

harnesses.name: OpenManus
harnesses.description: Open, invite-free general agent from the MetaGPT team: planning plus tool use over a multi-agent loop, aimed at reproducing Manus-style autonomous task completion on your own keys.

harnesses.name: crewAI
harnesses.description: Role-based agents (roles, goals, backstories) in Crews; Flows add event-driven and hierarchical control for production.

harnesses.name: ChatDev
harnesses.description: Multi-agent software-company simulation (CEO, CTO, programmer, tester) built on chat chains with communicative dehallucination; ChatDev 2.0 continues the line. MetaGPT's conversational sibling.

harnesses.name: openai-agents-python
harnesses.description: Handoffs, guardrails, and multi-LLM routing; minimal surface so you own the loop.

harnesses.name: Microsoft Agent Framework
harnesses.description: Microsoft's convergence of AutoGen and Semantic Kernel: build, orchestrate, and deploy agents and multi-agent workflows in Python and .NET, with graph-based workflows and checkpointing — the designated successor harness for both lines.

harnesses.name: hive
harnesses.description: Self-hosted multi-agent harness aimed at production workloads: human-in-the-loop checkpoints and a self-improving agent loop, distinct from single-session coding-agent shells.

harnesses.name: PraisonAI
harnesses.description: Autonomous multi-agent teams with a single entry point; emphasis on minimal config.

harnesses.name: omnigent
harnesses.description: Open-source meta-harness: orchestrates Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Pi, and custom agents behind one policy/sandboxing layer so teams swap harnesses without rewriting workflows.

harnesses.name: AG2
harnesses.description: AG2 (formerly AutoGen): the community-governed continuation of the original AutoGen project after Microsoft's fork diverged—conversable multi-agent groups, code execution, and human-in-the-loop under an open-source AgentOS banner. Graduated off the radar…

harnesses.name: AgentRL
harnesses.description: Multitask, multiturn RL for LLM agents; Ray-based scaling, rollout/actor workers—for teams that want to train agents, not just run them.

harnesses.name: AgentHub
harnesses.description: A desktop multi-agent management harness with specialized roles, skills, hooks, file watchers, quality gates, and traceable workflows.

harnesses.name: team-harness
harnesses.description: A provider-neutral coordination layer for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and other workers, with nested runs, persistent task state, and replayable logs.

harnesses.name: Warp Oz
harnesses.description: Warp's programmable control plane for local and cloud coding agents, with scheduling, parallel runs, hosted or self-hosted environments, audit trails, and API/CLI access.

harnesses.name: MCP Servers
harnesses.description: The official reference collection of Model Context Protocol servers (filesystem, git, fetch, memory, time, and more)—the canonical, vetted toolset agents connect to, and the pattern every other MCP server is measured against.

harnesses.name: Context7
harnesses.description: MCP server that injects up-to-date, version-specific library docs into an agent's context on demand; kills the stale-training-data hallucinations that plague codegen.

harnesses.name: chrome-devtools-mcp
harnesses.description: Google's official Chrome DevTools MCP server: exposes console, network, and performance-trace inspection as tool calls agents can drive directly, instead of a human clicking through the DevTools panel.

harnesses.name: aider
harnesses.description: Git-aware CLI pair programmer; edits in-repo, supports multiple models and MCP so agents see version control and tools.

harnesses.name: Playwright MCP
harnesses.description: Playwright's official MCP server: structured browser control (navigate, click, fill, extract) via the accessibility tree rather than screenshots, so web tasks stay fast and deterministic.

harnesses.name: continue
harnesses.description: Open-source IDE extension (VS Code, JetBrains); in-editor completion and chat with local or API models.

harnesses.name: github-mcp-server
harnesses.description: GitHub's official MCP server (Go): repos, issues, PRs, code search, Actions. Replaces the older community cyanheads/github-mcp-server as the canonical way to give agents GitHub access.

harnesses.name: MCP Python SDK
harnesses.description: Official SDK to build and consume MCP servers/clients in Python; stdio and SSE transports.

harnesses.name: MCP TypeScript SDK
harnesses.description: Official MCP implementation for Node/TS; reference for the protocol.

harnesses.name: MCP Inspector
harnesses.description: GUI to test and debug MCP servers; inspect tools, resources, and prompts.

harnesses.name: MCP Registry
harnesses.description: Official, community-driven registry for MCP servers—the "app store" MCP clients use to discover servers. Maintained by Anthropic + ecosystem maintainers; v0.1 API frozen, production-grade.

harnesses.name: Agent Governance Toolkit
harnesses.description: Microsoft's policy-enforcement layer for autonomous agents: zero-trust identity, execution sandboxing, and OWASP Agentic Top-10 coverage sit in front of the agent loop as a harness security layer—the governance counterpart to Infisical's agent-vault.

harnesses.name: mcp-context-forge
harnesses.description: IBM's official AI gateway/registry/proxy that sits in front of any MCP, A2A, or REST/gRPC API: unified endpoint, centralized discovery, guardrails, and plugin support—the enterprise front door for harness tool calling. Graduated off the radar this cycle.

harnesses.name: cocoindex-code
harnesses.description: Embedded, tree-sitter/AST-based code-search CLI and MCP server that gives coding agents fast semantic lookups over a repo instead of grepping or re-reading whole files into context.

harnesses.name: agent-vault
harnesses.description: Infisical's HTTP credential proxy that fronts secrets for Claude Code, OpenClaw, and other agent harnesses so the agent's tool calls never see raw credentials—a harness security layer, not an agent loop itself.

harnesses.name: Docker MCP Gateway
harnesses.description: Docker's official MCP CLI plugin / gateway; container-aware MCP tooling from Docker (replaces deprecated docker/mcp-servers path).

harnesses.name: Swamp
harnesses.description: A local CLI for agents to create deterministic, reviewable operational workflows, typed models, auditable runs, and versioned outputs.

harnesses.name: puppeteer-real-browser-mcp
harnesses.description: Puppeteer MCP with real-browser and anti-detection; for agents that need to drive sites that block headless.

harnesses.name: Better-OpenCodeMCP
harnesses.description: MCP server for OpenCode/Crush: async task execution, model bridging (e.g. Claude→Gemini), process pooling.

harnesses.name: Harness Hat
harnesses.description: A local Docker control plane that gives coding agents filtered workspaces and governs commands, networking, subagents, and logs with repository policy.

harnesses.name: agentlog

harnesses.name: claude-mem
